apify.seo_title: Remote Jobs Aggregator API for n8n and Job Boards
apify.seo_description: Aggregate and deduplicate remote jobs from four public sources. Filter by keyword, location, and age for n8n, Make, job boards, recruiters, and AI agents.
apify.ai_ml_example_title: Find Remote AI and Machine Learning Jobs Daily
apify.evidence: GitHub Actions run 31839108156 passed for commit c6ff94c, and Apify build 0.0.10 cloned that exact commit and succeeded. A second public AI and machine-learning task was saved with four keywords, any-match mode, seven-day age, 50-result limit, descriptions disabled, and 256 MB memory without running it; Console still shows task runs 0. Anonymous HTML and Markdown return HTTP 200 and at least one current CDN variant exposes the corrected input, while another edge variant still serves the older input during the documented 30-minute cache window. Store README propagation is also pending. The last Console Insights values remain provisional and show no settled revenue

apify_markdown_code_to_image.seo_title: Markdown and Code to PNG Image Automation API
apify_markdown_code_to_image.seo_description: Render Markdown, code, tables, quotes, and AI answers into PNG images through an API for n8n, Make, newsletters, documentation, and social media.
apify_markdown_code_to_image.chatgpt_example_title: Convert ChatGPT Markdown Answers to PNG
apify_markdown_code_to_image.evidence: Seven repository tests, three schema validations, and GitHub Actions run 31837150196 passed for commit d814279. Public build API confirms Apify build 0.0.5 cloned that commit and succeeded. A second ChatGPT Markdown-to-PNG task was published without running it; anonymous HTML and Markdown are HTTP 200, indexable, and show a valid one-document paper-theme input. Public Actor users, runs, and last-run timestamp are unchanged. Store HTML contains the new link while Store Markdown remains cached. Prior anonymous PNG verification remains HTTP 200 image/png; no signed URLs are stored

apify_uk_company_change_alerts.supplier_example_title: Monitor UK Supplier Status and Filing Changes
apify_uk_company_change_alerts.evidence: Nine local tests, compile checks, schema validation, fixture execution, and GitHub Actions run 31839971442 passed for commit 576c25c. Apify build 0.0.7 cloned that exact commit and succeeded without running the Actor; the public API shows seven builds while total runs remain four and total users remain one. Source fetches are now bounded to ten concurrent requests so the documented 100-company watchlist fits within the 300-second Actor timeout under the 20-second per-request ceiling, while output order and successful-check charging remain unchanged. Store and both supplier Example HTML/Markdown endpoints remain HTTP 200 with valid public input. The last Console Insights check still showed zero paying users and zero profit, so settled revenue remains zero
